mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY > 2% does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the UNRATE increase does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdown indicators.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real estate activity (HOUST) for two consecutive months signals a weakening demand in the housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the decline in HOUST does not correlate with broader economic weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the INDPRO decline does not correlate with subsequent supply chain issues.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) is rising, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction between FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the interaction between PAYEMS and UNRATE does not correlate with subsequent economic strength.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real final sales (RSAFS) for two consecutive quarters signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances despite the positive signal, or the RSAFS increase does not correlate with subsequent economic growth.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) combined with rising consumer prices (CPIAUCSL) signals supply constraints and inflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction between INDPRO and CPIAUCSL does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdown and inflationary pressures.
